judge.rationale: The candidate left the task half-finished, as reflected in its own `.lore/dod.md` file which remains committed in the diff with unchecked facets. Function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` schemas are compiled once at registration time instead of dynamically per call with `WeakMap` caching, breaking a core requirement of the ticket. Furthermore, most unit tests requested in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing (with only 4 acceptance tests placed in a separate `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file), and the one-line JSDoc comment on `execute` was never added. Finally, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made, and the `CHANGELOG.md` entry is incomplete.
